prompts.title: Walk Away From the Jukebox
prompts.concept: An original rebellious electric guitarist walks away from a burning jukebox in a city alley, carrying a guitar case with abstract, non-branded sticker shapes.
prompts.intended_garment_use: Front graphic for black or washed charcoal tee; alternate back print for black hoodie.
prompts.print_notes: One-color or two-color distressed screen-print treatment; preserve a clear silhouette and avoid tiny sticker details. No readable third-party marks.

provenance.source_entry: gritty vintage illustration of a rebellious electric guitar player walking away from a burning jukebox
provenance.curation_decision: retained and rewritten for original, print-aware use

prompts.title: Rooftop After the Set
prompts.concept: A lone guitarist sits on a rooftop at night under a crescent moon, with restrained stars, soft clouds, and a low city glow suggesting the quiet after a live performance.
prompts.intended_garment_use: Centered front print for faded black, navy, or dark forest tee; small left-chest mark may be derived later.
prompts.print_notes: Use a limited halftone field and open negative space. Keep the moon and guitar readable at thumbnail size; no gradients that depend on transparent rendering.

provenance.source_entry: peaceful vintage-style illustration of a guitarist sitting on a rooftop at night
provenance.curation_decision: retained with simplified composition and original music-world framing

prompts.title: Porchlight Blues
prompts.concept: A weathered, fictional blues guitarist sits on a wooden porch with a hollow-body guitar, porchlight shadows, worn boards, and a restrained southern-night atmosphere.
prompts.intended_garment_use: Large back print for washed black or dark brown tee; small front title lockup only after concept approval.
prompts.print_notes: Favor rough linework, woodgrain texture, and two to three spot colors. Remove bottles, labels, or props that could imply a third-party brand or endorsement.

provenance.source_entry: weathered blues guitarist sitting on a wooden porch
provenance.curation_decision: retained; prop language narrowed to avoid brand and lifestyle claims

prompts.title: Amplifier Constellation
prompts.concept: A fictional guitarist floats in an abstract night sky, tethered to a glowing amplifier while sparse star paths echo musical motion without literal notes or copied imagery.
prompts.intended_garment_use: Centered front print for black or deep navy tee; suitable for a restrained cosmic sub-series.
prompts.print_notes: Translate the nebula into halftone texture and use the amplifier as the visual anchor. Keep the artwork opaque, separable, and readable in two to four spot colors.

provenance.source_entry: cosmic dreamscape illustration of a lone guitarist floating in space

prompts.title: Still Plugged In
prompts.concept: A fictional older guitar player stands on a dim stage with a glowing amplifier, coiled cable, long shadows, and a small perseverance message reserved for later lettering review.
prompts.intended_garment_use: Large back print for black hoodie or washed charcoal tee.
prompts.print_notes: Treat the phrase as provisional because it is generic. Concept approval must include a distinct Tyler James Drake naming lockup before any exact image is approved.

provenance.source_entry: older guitar player standing on a dimly lit stage with Still Plugged In
provenance.curation_decision: retained as generic-marked; title and lettering require concept review
